label: arsenite oxidation
definition: A metabolism in which an organism enzymatically oxidizes arsenite to arsenate as an energy-generating electron donor or detoxification substrate.
observations: Microbial As(III)-to-As(V) oxidation trait; absent from live METPO except for METPO:1000840 obsolete Arsenite oxidation, distinct from cytosolic ArsC arsenate reduction and arsenite efflux captured by arsenic tolerance records.
